screen.name: Audio Attachment Recording
screen.purpose: Record an audio attachment for a task. Saving the file does not transcribe it.

excludes: capture warm-up before the first sample

behavior.onStop: Finish capture and save an audio attachment on the task. Do not call speech-to-text.
behavior.onCancel: Discard the current recording. Do not create an attachment.
behavior.onPause: Stop appending audio and freeze the timer. Already captured audio stays.
behavior.sizeLimit: Stop and save when the captured file reaches the product audio size limit. There is no countdown for that limit.
behavior.unavailableCapture: When the device can only produce uncompressed audio, this screen does not start. Title recording stays available.
behavior.transcription: Not available on this screen. Transcribe with AI is an action on the saved attachment.

recording.description: Capture is in progress. The timer advances and the waveform shows the live microphone level.

paused.description: Capture is held. The timer does not advance. The waveform rests.

saving.description: Stop was pressed or the size limit was reached. The file is being stored as an attachment. Speech-to-text is not called.

saved.description: The attachment exists on the task. This screen closes and the Audio attachments section shows the new recording.

error.description: Permission failed, pause failed, or the file could not be saved. No attachment is created from the failed attempt.

visualRules: Use the voiceRecorder and audioWaveform components from design-system.json.
Do not define screen-specific colors, radii or spacing.
The reference PNG is a visual target for composition and density, not a source of token values.
Do not reproduce the glowing halo from the reference. The microphone uses the thin accent ring from voiceRecorder.
The waveform is a live level meter. Do not use a decorative looping animation.
Keep the header, microphone, timer and actions as one compact group. Do not leave a large empty field between the microphone and the actions.
Pause, the open-ended timer and save-without-transcription belong to this screen. Do not copy them into the title recorder.

reference.description: Approved composition reference for the audio attachment recorder. The halo and the decorative waveform in the image are superseded by voiceRecorder and audioWaveform.

angular.note: Opened from Add audio recording on Create Task and Edit Task. Same recorder services as title recording, with pause and without automatic transcription.
